title: AWS for .NET Overview
description: Understand what AWS offers .NET developers and how to prepare your local environment.
longDescription: This module introduces AWS from a .NET developer's perspective. You will learn the main AWS service categories, create a free AWS account, install the AWS SDK for .NET, and choose the right AWS service for a new ASP.NET Core project.
whatYouLearn: Explain AWS's value for ASP.NET Core developers
Create and configure an AWS account
Install the AWS SDK for .NET and AWS CLI
Choose the right AWS service for hosting, storage, and data
